# Evidence SPA envelope vectors

Generated by `TestSPAGoldenEnvelopes` (`internal/sign/spa_golden_test.go`). Do not edit by hand.

Regenerate after any change to the envelope format, canonical JSON, or the manual-evidence record:

```
go test ./internal/sign/ -run TestSPAGoldenEnvelopes -update
```

Then copy every file in this folder except this README, byte for byte, to the Evidence SPA's
`src/lib/verification/__fixtures__/golden/` in the same task. The SPA's `/verify` tests read
them from there.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `<name>.json` | The envelope exactly as `check` writes it to the vault (canonical JSON plus a newline) |
| `<name>.canonical.txt` | The bytes the signature covers: canonical JSON of `{format_version, produced_at, records}` |
| `<name>.<folder>.pdf` | The PDF a manual record's `file_hash` attests to, named as the vault names it under `attachments/` |

Vectors: `basic` (key order, non-ASCII, HTML characters, escapes, record scope), `bignum`
(integers beyond 2^53), `manual` (a single-folder manual-evidence record from the real `manual.pdf`
plugin), `fanout` (a vendor fan-out record: two members with PDFs, one missing, one exempt).

The vectors are signed with a fixed test key so they are reproducible. The CLI itself signs every
file with a fresh key. The test fails when a regenerated vector differs from the committed one,
and re-verifies every committed envelope and PDF hash on each run.
